# Review triage: 01-messy-ts-app (39 findings)

**Verdict: request changes.** 5 findings block the merge, 20 get a warning and 14 can be ignored.

## How I sorted them

- **Block merge:** severity `high` with `agent_risk` ≥ 0.35. That means a real correctness defect that an agent is also likely to spread. I also block two `medium` findings that will certainly break every other machine or environment; their reasons are given below.
- **Warn:** any other `medium` finding, any `high` finding with low `agent_risk` (a code-health or asset issue, not a correctness one), and any `low` finding with `agent_risk` ≥ 0.35.
- **Ignore:** severity `low` with `agent_risk` < 0.35.

The PR adds everything from an empty baseline, so `blast_radius` is 0 and `recency` is 0 on every finding. That leaves severity and `agent_risk` doing the ranking, with confidence as a check.

## 🛑 Block merge (5)

| ID | Finding | Sev (score) | agent_risk | Conf | Why block |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 00026 | Two different `Invoice` declarations (`src/api/state.ts:9` vs `src/billing.ts:19`) | high (0.96) | 0.37 | 0.82 | Highest severity in the scan. The two disagree on 6 fields, including money fields (`subtotalCents`, `taxCents`, `discountCents`, `currency`) and `userId`. Nothing checks them against each other, so an agent editing one copy will quietly get billing data wrong. |
| 00010 | Two different `User` declarations (`src/api/state.ts:4` vs `src/billing.ts:4`) | high (0.90) | 0.37 | 0.82 | Same problem: one copy lacks the timestamp field `createdAt`. Fix it in the same change as 00026. |
| 00005 | `d` in `src/date.ts` mixes UTC and local Date methods (`getUTCFullYear` L9, `getMonth` L41) | high (0.80) | 0.39 | 0.85 | Results silently depend on the host's timezone, so dates can be off by a day or month near midnight or month ends. Of the three high-severity findings that block on the score rule, this one has the highest agent_risk. |
| 00016 | Hardcoded path `/Users/andrew/dev/crimes/schema.json` (`src/api/files.ts:9`) | medium (0.60) | 0.31 | 0.90 | **Override.** The scores alone say warn, but this path exists on exactly one machine. CI, deploys and every other developer will fail. Confidence is high and the fix is quick. |
| 00015 | Hardcoded `localhost:3000` (`src/api/files.ts:8`) | medium (0.60) | 0.31 | 0.90 | **Override**, for the same reason: it can only work against one local dev server. Move it to an env var or config. |

## ⚠️ Warn (20)

**Medium severity, highest agent_risk first:**

| ID | Finding | Sev | agent_risk | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 00001 | 6 direct `Date.now()`/`new Date()` calls in `src/date.ts` | 0.60 | **0.45** | Highest agent_risk in the scan. One of the readings decides a branch (L4). Inject a clock alongside the 00005 fix. |
| 00003 | No AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md or skill files | 0.60 | 0.43 | Agents can't discover how to use the `messy` bin. |
| 00004 | The literal `"enterprise"` appears in 4 files across 4 areas | 0.50 | 0.43 | The same business rule is copied in several places. |
| 00006 | `/settings/billing` labelled "Plans" in one nav file and "Billing" in the other | 0.60 | 0.39 | |
| 00007 | `/settings/billing` route has 4 competing names | 0.60 | 0.39 | Same root cause as 00006. |
| 00009 | `new Date("…")` with no timezone (L29, L33) | 0.60 | 0.38 | Borderline block; related to 00005. |
| 00012 | `calculateRefundPreview` saves an audit record and sends an email | 0.55 | 0.35 | A function named as a harmless preview has side effects. Callers will treat it as safe to call. |
| 00013 | Refund-permission rule exists only in a comment (`billing.ts:39`) | 0.50 | 0.35 | "Only owners can refund enterprise plans…" isn't enforced anywhere. This is worth a human look, because it may be a missing authorization check. |
| 00014 | Adds `86400000` ms as a day (`date.ts:52`) | 0.60 | 0.33 | Wrong on daylight-saving change days. |
| 00017 | Four different words for one concept: account, organisation, team, workspace | 0.55 | 0.31 | |
| 00025 | Test "renders the enterprise plan" has no assertions | 0.45 | 0.28 | It gives false confidence. |
| 00028 | Commented-out refund code in `billing.ts:33-37` | 0.45 | 0.24 | |
| 00029 | 7 direct clock reads in `billing.ts` | 0.60 | 0.24 | They only record the time and never decide a branch, so the risk is lower. |
| 00034 | 14 TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX markers in `src/todo.ts` | 0.40 | 0.10 | |
| 00036 | `billing.ts` is 310 lines (threshold 300) | 0.60 | 0.07 | Only just over the line. |

**High severity but low agent_risk** (real code-health or asset issues, not correctness bugs):

| ID | Finding | Sev | agent_risk | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 00033 | `generateInvoice` is 204 lines, 3.4× the threshold | 0.90 | 0.13 | Worth splitting up, but it isn't a defect in itself. |
| 00035 | `partner-logo.svg` embeds base64 JPEG and PNG images | 0.75 | 0.08 | An asset quality issue. It doesn't put the code at risk. |

**Low severity but agent_risk ≥ 0.35:**

| ID | Finding | Sev | agent_risk |
|---|---|---|---|
| 00002 | `resolvePaymentResult` returns 3 unrelated shapes and has no return type | 0.30 | 0.44 |
| 00008 | `describeCheckout` takes an untyped options object with 6 fields | 0.30 | 0.39 |
| 00011 | `!disableBilling && !skipRetry` double-negative condition | 0.25 | 0.37 |

## ✅ Ignore (14)

All of these are low severity with agent_risk < 0.35.

| ID | Finding | Sev | agent_risk |
|---|---|---|---|
| 00018 | 1 direct `Date.now()` in `api/state.ts` | 0.35 | 0.29 |
| 00019 | Date built by string concatenation (`date.ts:41`) | 0.30 | 0.29 |
| 00020 | `toLocaleDateString()` with no locale | 0.30 | 0.29 |
| 00021 | Singular/plural name mismatch (`users: User`, `invoice: Invoice[]`) | 0.30 | 0.29 |
| 00022 / 00023 / 00024 | Routes nothing links to: `/account/subscription`, `/team`, `/workspace/members` | 0.40 | 0.29 |
| 00027 | Broken doc link `docs/teams.md` → `./setup.md` | 0.35 | 0.25 |
| 00030 | Weak assertion in "creates an invoice" | 0.25 | 0.24 |
| 00031 | `vitest` is imported but not declared in package.json (test files only) | 0.25 | 0.24 |
| 00032 | Swallowed email error in `generateInvoice` | 0.35 | 0.16 |
| 00037 | 254 KB hero PNG | 0.40 | 0.05 |
| 00038 | 32×32 PNG icon that could be an SVG | 0.35 | 0.05 |
| 00039 | 4 TODO markers in `billing.ts` | 0.20 | 0.04 |

Two of these are cheap to fix while you're in the area, even though they don't need to hold the PR:
- **00032:** the email failure is silently discarded. Fix it as part of splitting `generateInvoice` (00033).
- **00031:** a clean install will fail to find `vitest`. Add it as a dev dependency.

## Other notes

- **A suppression has lapsed.** The scan's coverage section reports one suppression entry for `src/billing.ts` that no longer matches its finding: the same issue is now reported under a different fingerprint, with nothing silencing it. Before relying on this triage, run `crimes migrate-pins --format json` and review the result.
- **Suggested fix order:**
  1. Unify `Invoice` and `User` (00026, 00010).
  2. Fix the date and timezone handling in `src/date.ts` (00005, then 00001, 00009, 00014 together).
  3. Move the localhost URL and home-directory path into config (00015, 00016).
